description: Language-neutral CLL backend conformance cases. Each case runs its steps in order against a fresh, empty backend. Arguments and results use the contract's portable encodings. A case runs only when the backend implements every listed interface, has every capability in requires and none in unless.

capabilities.digest-append: append stores a bare 32-byte identity (absent: append of a new identity is unsupported)
capabilities.reopen: the runner can close the backend and open the same durable state again (the reopen step)

cases.name: entries/empty-log
cases.description: A new log has no entries; lookups of any 32-byte value are not found.

cases.name: entries/append-and-idempotent
cases.description: New values get dense 1-based sequences; a repeated value returns its original entry and time.

cases.name: entries/scan-bounds
cases.description: Scans return entries after afterSeq in order, at most limit, and reject out-of-range arguments.

cases.name: entries/invalid-values
cases.description: Values that are not 32 bytes are invalid for append and lookup, and nothing is stored.

cases.name: entries/time-range
cases.description: Append keeps millisecond times exactly and rejects times outside the ECMAScript Date range.

cases.name: entries/extended-years
cases.description: Times outside years 0001..9999 within the ECMAScript Date range use the six-digit year form.

cases.name: entries/digest-append-unsupported
cases.description: A store without digest-append validates the value, then refuses a new identity as unsupported.

cases.name: checkpoint/initial-state
cases.description: A new backend has empty CLL state.

cases.name: checkpoint/first-commit
cases.description: The first commit expects size 0 and no checkpoint, and is returned by loadCll.

cases.name: checkpoint/state-without-checkpoint
cases.description: Nodes and indexedSeq may advance without a checkpoint, and firstPendingAt round-trips.

cases.name: checkpoint/compare-and-set
cases.description: A stale expected size or checkpoint is contention, before any validation of next.

cases.name: checkpoint/invalid-structure
cases.description: A next state whose nodes, size or checkpoint tuple break the structural rules is invalid.

cases.name: checkpoint/invalid-witness-rows
cases.description: Witness rows inside a commit follow the witness rules, and a key may appear once.

cases.name: checkpoint/append-only
cases.description: Existing nodes cannot change and size cannot shrink.

cases.name: checkpoint/checkpoint-transitions
cases.description: A checkpoint cannot be removed, move backward, or change at the size it already holds.

cases.name: witness/get
cases.description: getWitness validates the key, then returns the row or not found.

cases.name: witness/commit-cas
cases.description: commitWitness validates next, then compares attempts and checkpoint bytes with the stored row.

cases.name: witness/invalid-rows
cases.description: commitWitness rejects rows that break the witness rules as invalid.

cases.name: witness/commit-cll-merge
cases.description: commitCll inserts new witness keys, keeps existing rows as stored, never deletes rows, and rejects rebinding a key.

cases.name: witness/pending-order
cases.description: pendingWitnesses returns due rows without receipt or permanent failure, by numeric size then witness ID.

cases.name: lifecycle/close
cases.description: close is repeatable, and every other operation then fails closed before validating arguments.

cases.name: lifecycle/reopen
cases.description: A persistent backend reopens with the same entries, CLL state and witness rows.
